name: config-schema
//: The published config JSON Schema (served from GitHub Pages at its $id) — the contract every shipped config and the loader agree on. Its test (scripts/validate-schema.py) validates the schema itself plus every config the project ships (examples/ and the dogfood .allowlister.jsonc) against it; the validator and those configs are inputs, so a change to any of them reaches this project without an edge to the crate. type:contract: it depends on nothing it serves.
